title: Dimension equality for maximal-ideal completion
statement: For a commutative Noetherian local ring A, the Krull dimension of its maximal-ideal adic completion equals that of A.

source.place: Lemma Tag 07NV, alternative flat local proof

proof.text: Apply the flat height formula to the completion map; the closed fibre is the residue field and has dimension zero.

lean.statement: theorem completion_dimension_eq (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A] : ringKrullDim (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A) = ringKrullDim A
